corpusIndexIdentity.why: partial-custody entries deliberately carry no form number; this record binds by exact SHA-256 and by the printed face, and the corpus index carries the same determination as a sibling identityDetermination record

ownershipDetermination: JDF 611 Guide to Sealing Conviction Records (district or county court case) (R: August 7, 2024) lists this document among the forms the petitioner files and says how much of it to complete: "JDF 614 Notice (Just do §§ A-C)". The caption is the petitioner's and everything after it is the court's, so only caption facts bind and every other field is refused by role.
whatThisDocumentIs: The court's order setting a hearing on the motion and the notice of that hearing, used when the court finds a hearing necessary. The movant tenders it with sections A-C completed; the hearing date and time, the finding that a hearing is necessary, the objection deadline and the signature are the court's.
coBrandingRule: No LegalEase or partner branding may be added to the official form.
